    • getPoint

      public abstract Optional<DataPoint> getPoint(long currentTimestamp, UUID playerUUID, String playerName)
      Implement this method to return newest datapoint.

      DataPoint should return value for X axis and all values for Y axis. VALUES OF SAME SERIES OF DATA NEED TO BE AT SAME INDEX ALL THE TIME.

      Parameters:
      currentTimestamp - Epoch millisecond of method call time.
      playerUUID - UUID of the player.
      playerName - Name of the player.
      Returns:
      Optional.empty() if there's no new point to add.

    • getPointHistory

      public List<DataPoint> getPointHistory(long currentTimestamp, UUID playerUUID, String playerName)
      Override this method to return point history for your data.

      VALUES OF SAME SERIES OF DATA NEED TO BE AT SAME INDEX ALL THE TIME.

      Parameters:
      currentTimestamp - Epoch millisecond of method call time.
      playerUUID - UUID of the player.
      playerName - Name of the player.
      Returns:
      List of points to add to Plan, each DataPoint including value for X axis and all values for Y axis.

    • getSeriesMetadata

      public abstract List<SeriesMetadata> getSeriesMetadata()
      Implement this method to return SeriesMetadata for each Y axis value.

      VALUES OF SAME SERIES OF DATA NEED TO BE AT SAME INDEX ALL THE TIME.

      This method will be called when Extension is registered, and any time DataPoint has more values than previously.

      Index in List defines which series metadata is for - if series stops getting data return null in that index.

      Returns:
      List.of({metadata for Y series of DataPoint#values[0]}, {metadata for Y series of DataPoint#values[1]}, ...etc)
      Throws:
      NotReadyException - If you can't call this yet - empty metadata will be given.
      RuntimeException - Data source registration will fail.
